correctness.rationale: PASS: KG(6,2) has 15 labeled vertices (edges of K6) and 45 adjacency pairs corresponding to disjoint edge pairs. The antiferromagnetic three-color energy at field x=h/J is e−nx for n sites of favored color 0. Fresh independent full enumeration of all 3^15=14,348,907 labeled spin configurations recovered each of the 16 submitted sector minima and degeneracies, and confirmed exactly 180 zero-field minimizers (three conflicts). A separately constructed 30 ordered-point-pair times six color permutations two-star-plus-four-clique family contains exactly those 180 and no extras. Exact lower-envelope comparison yields branches 15,3−4x,3−6x,15−10x,45−15x, transitions x=−3,0,3,6, with tie totals 5862,180,2652,1583. Here complete finite enumeration, not statistical sampling, is an exhaustive certificate for the fixed graph.

Exhaustively classifying minimum three monochromatic disjoint pairs, 180 structural minimizers and exact field-induced selection transitions gives a natural, nontrivial finite invariant suitable as a benchmark for antiferromagnetic coloring and finite-field degeneracy. This is more than renaming chi(G)=4 or merely reporting a negative calculation.
